title: Grade 8 French — Tue, Jun 17
description: Le futur simple — Day 2 of 5: -re verbs (drop final -e) + common verb practice
subject: french

questions.question: For -re verbs in the futur simple, you must first _____ before adding the endings.
options: drop the final -e from the infinitive
questions.explanation: For -re verbs: drop the final -e from the infinitive, then add the futur simple endings. Example: prendr- (from prendre), vendr- (from vendre).

questions.question: What is the futur simple stem of 'prendre'?
questions.explanation: prendre → drop the final -e → prendr-. Then add endings: je prendrai, tu prendras, il prendra...

questions.question: Conjugate 'prendre' in the futur simple for 'je'.
What is the futur simple of 'tu vendras'?
questions.explanation: vendre → vendr- + -as = tu vendras = 'you will sell'.

questions.question: Complete: 'nous _____ (attendre, futur simple)'.
questions.explanation: attendre → attendr- + -ons = nous attendrons (we will wait).

questions.question: Choose the correct futur simple: 'ils _____ (répondre)'.
questions.explanation: répondre → répondr- + -ont = ils répondront (they will answer).

questions.question: Identify the futur simple form: 'elle comprendra'.
questions.explanation: comprendre → comprendra = comprendra (3rd person singular futur simple). 'She will understand.'

questions.question: Now mixing verb types. Which is the correct futur simple of 'je lire' (lire = to read)?
questions.explanation: lire → drop final -e → lir- + -ai = je lirai (I will read). Lire is an -re verb.

questions.question: Complete: 'vous _____ (écrire, futur simple)' — écrire = to write.
questions.explanation: écrire → écrir- + -ez = vous écrirez (you will write).

questions.question: Translate: 'Ils prendront le train demain.'
options: They take the train every day.
They will take the train tomorrow.
questions.explanation: prendront = ils + prendre (futur simple -ont form) = 'will take'. 'They will take the train tomorrow.'

questions.question: Fill in: 'La semaine prochaine, nous _____ (attendre) les résultats.'
questions.explanation: 'La semaine prochaine' (next week) signals future. attendr- + -ons = attendrons.

questions.question: Which verb type does NOT need to drop the final -e for the futur simple stem?
questions.explanation: -er verbs keep the full infinitive as stem (parler → je parlerai). -re verbs drop the final -e (prendre → prendr-).

questions.question: What is wrong with 'Je prendrerai le bus'?
questions.explanation: prendre → drop -e → prendr- + -ai = je prendrai. 'Prendrerai' is a common error (keeping the -e). Correct: je prendrai.

questions.question: Give the futur simple of 'elle répondra'. What infinitive does it come from?
options: répondre — correct, elle répondra = she will answer
répondre — but the form is wrong; should be répondera
questions.explanation: répondre → répondr- + -a = elle répondra (she will answer). répondre is a regular -re verb.

questions.question: Put this sentence in the futur simple: 'Je prends le bus.' (change to tomorrow)
options: Demain, je prends le bus. (no change needed)
questions.explanation: prendre → prendr- + -ai = je prendrai. 'Tomorrow, I will take the bus.' = 'Demain, je prendrai le bus.'
